account.title: Set up InPost account
account.description: Choose the country your InPost account is registered in.

sign_in.title: Sign in to InPost
sign_in.description:
Open this link in a browser and sign in with your InPost account (phone number and SMS code):

{authorize_url}

Enter the SMS code on InPost's page, not here. If InPost then asks you to sign in by e-mail and you end up on your InPost account page instead, open the link above again while still signed in.

Afterwards the page will not finish loading — that is expected. Copy the full address from your browser's address bar and paste it below.

data_description.callback_url: The full address from your browser's address bar after signing in. It contains "callback?code=".

tracking.title: Set up InPost tracking
tracking.description: Create a hub for manually added tracking codes.

reauth_confirm.title: InPost sign-in expired

error.invalid_auth: InPost rejected the sign-in. Open the link again and sign in once more.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach InPost. Please try again.
error.invalid_redirect: That does not look like the address the sign-in page sent you to. Make sure you copied the whole address after signing in.
error.wrong_market: That sign-in was for an InPost account in a different country than the one you chose. Your browser may still be signed in to another InPost account: open the link in a private window and sign in again.

abort.already_configured: That InPost account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That sign-in was for a different InPost account. Sign in with the account this entry was set up for.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking an InPost parcel by its tracking code.

country.name: Country
country.description: Which country hub to add it to. Only needed when more than one hub is set up.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking an InPost parcel by its tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The InPost tracking code to stop tracking.

country.name: Country
country.description: Which country hub to remove it from. Only needed when more than one hub is set up.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
